research_question: What is the three-seed matched continuous benchmark on MMECG loso_v2, and does REM-Net differ from any baseline once seed variance is included?
no_training: Aggregation of the 198 sealed folds (6 models x 3 seeds x 11 folds); nothing is trained or selected.

inputs.completeness_check: every fold must be stage COMPLETE with test metrics present

aggregation.per_seed: fold-macro mean over the 11 test subjects, population std across folds
aggregation.headline: mean +/- std ACROSS THE THREE SEEDS of the per-seed fold-macro values (METRIC_CONTRACT: key conclusions need >= 3 seeds)
aggregation.seed_stability: across-seed std reported beside the headline
aggregation.paired_statistics: per fold, metrics are averaged over the three seeds; paired two-sided Wilcoxon on those 11 seed-averaged fold values, REM-Net versus each baseline, with folds won; five comparisons, uncorrected, descriptive
aggregation.rate_metrics: RR/HR aggregated only over (model, seed, fold) entries with rr_coverage >= 0.80; excluded entries listed
aggregation.heavy_tailed: above_10hz_energy_ratio reported as median with min/max
aggregation.units: RMSE/MAE/region MAE in per-record z-score units
